# Who is overdue to rebook, and who has already left?

> Free lapsed-client report for salons, barbers, groomers, physio, dental and cleaning businesses. Paste your visits (client, date, amount) to see who is overdue and still worth a call, who has probably gone, and a back-test that says whether to trust the ranking. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
